subject: Next steps after discovery — pilot scope & timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimbusretail.com>, Tom Hsu <t.hsu@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Maya / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side and the recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of discovery (high level)
- Primary goal: Reduce search query latency on product pages and improve recommendation precision during peak traffic.
- Current constraints: multi-tenant SaaS on GCP, strict PII filters on customer queries, procurement requires a pilot SOW.
- Success metrics: 30% lower average token latency on cold queries, 10% lift in add-to-cart from recommendations.

Proposed pilot (what we discussed)
- 4-week pilot against a subset of the catalog (approx. 20k SKUs)
- Redwood Dedicated reserved pool (1x A100 equivalent) with KV caching enabled and prefix caching for the top 10k queries
- Integration touchpoints: engineering will validate API routing and help us generate a sample workload

Open items / asks for Nimbus
1) Confirm decision owner for the pilot + legal contact for SOW (Procurement email looks like procurement@nimbusretail.com)
2) Share a short sample of typical product queries (anonymized) and expected peak qps
3) Confirm whether data residency requires EU-only if any test customers are EU-based

Attachments: I attached a draft pilot MOP and a one-page trial quote (nimbus-pilot-mop.pdf, redwood-trial-quote-v1.pdf) for your review.

If the scope looks right, next steps:
- I can send a pilot SOW and calendar invite for the kickoff next week (June 7–11 window)
- Ben (cc'd) will be on the kickoff call to align on success metrics and RU/ops checklist

Would love a short confirmation on the decision owner and whether the proposed timeline works.

Thanks,
--
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimbusretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <t.hsu@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-06-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick clarifying questions before we loop in procurement: 
1) Can you confirm ballpark pricing for a 4-week pilot on the Dedicated pool you mentioned?
2) Are there any data sharing templates or minimal data we need to supply for the pilot (we prefer anonymized examples)?

Tom and I can get you a sanitized set of queries this week. Procurement (cc'd) will need the SOW + quote to start their internal review.

Best,
Maya
Senior Product Manager, Nimbus Retail
maya.patel@nimbusretail.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-06-09T15:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Maya —

Thanks — pricing nutshell: for the 4-week Dedicated pilot we typically combine a fixed capacity reservation for the pool + short-term usage on top. Ballpark: $18k–24k depending on the exact qps/sequence length; I can push a more detailed line-item quote once you share the qps profile.

Data: anonymized query samples are perfect. No PII required. If you want a template, I attached the minimal sample schema in the MOP.

I haven't heard back from procurement after sending the draft SOW last week — looping Ben so he can help if we need a procurement intro. Any chance you can nudge procurement on timing? If it helps, we can also do a pilot acceptance checklist to speed approvals.

Short bump — are you still targeting early July for the kickoff?

Thanks,
--
Lauren

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Hsu <t.hsu@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: 2026-07-14T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final nudge — archive the file if this isn't a priority

Hi Maya / Tom —

Wanted to send one final touch before I archive the opportunity on my side. I haven't seen a reply to the pricing note or the SOW we shared; totally understand timelines shift. Two quick options so we don't leave this open unintentionally: 

Option A — Keep the file open: you confirm you'd like us to hold the pilot window for mid-July to early August and we'll convert the draft SOW into a formal DocuSign link (I can also coordinate a 20-minute procurement intro call with Ben).

Option B — Archive for now: if this isn't a priority, tell me to close the file and I'll re-open later on request. No hard feelings. If you prefer, I can set a 90-day reminder to check back.

If I don't hear back by Friday (2026-07-16), I'll assume Option B and archive the record — you're always welcome to hit reply and we can pick up immediately.

Appreciate the time — and if there's a different owner I should loop in, please let me know.

Best,
--
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
